team.name: Motunrayo Linda Idowu
team.imageAlt: Photo placeholder for Motunrayo Linda Idowu
team.bio: Motunrayo Linda Idowu is the founder and Community Director of Girls Unplugged: Bloom & Glow Circle. She created the community to give girls a space to connect, have honest conversations, discover opportunities, build confidence, and grow together.
team.longBio: Girls Unplugged began with a simple idea: girls should not have to navigate everything alone. What started as an online sisterhood has grown into a community where girls from different parts of Africa can connect, share experiences, celebrate one another, discover opportunities, and support each other through different seasons of life.

teamIntro.label: Our people
teamIntro.title: A community built with intention.
paragraphs: Behind every conversation, activity, guest session, opportunity, and community moment is a group of people contributing their time, ideas, skills, and energy to make Girls Unplugged what it is.
We are growing this community carefully, keeping the girls at the heart of what we do and creating room for more people to contribute as the circle grows.

howWeWork.title: Listen
howWeWork.description: We pay attention to what girls actually need, rather than assuming we already have all the answers.

howWeWork.title: Collaborate
howWeWork.description: We believe good ideas become stronger when people bring their different experiences and skills together.

howWeWork.title: Create
howWeWork.description: We turn conversations and ideas into activities, opportunities, resources, and experiences that girls can actually use.

howWeWork.title: Grow
howWeWork.description: We are still learning, improving, and becoming better as a community.

founderSection.label: Founder
founderSection.name: Motunrayo Linda Idowu
paragraphs: Girls Unplugged started with a simple idea: girls should not have to navigate everything alone.

What began as a small online sisterhood has grown into a community where girls from different parts of Africa can connect, have honest conversations, celebrate one another, discover opportunities, and grow together.
Motunrayo continues to lead the community with a focus on creating meaningful experiences rather than simply building another online group.
founderSection.quote: A space does not have to start big to matter. Sometimes, it just has to start.

joinTeam.label: Want to contribute?
joinTeam.title: There is room for your voice too.
joinTeam.description: Girls Unplugged is growing. If you have a skill, idea, experience, opportunity, or simply a genuine desire to support girls, there are different ways you can contribute.
